parse_face_annotation: parse raw CocoWholeBody face annotation data into structured instance info with keypoints and bounding box
build_face_dataset: build a CocoWholeBodyFaceDataset instance for face keypoint localization using COCO style annotations
register_face_dataset_module: register the CocoWholeBodyFaceDataset class in the mmpose DATASETS registry for face pose estimation
filter_invalid_face_instances: filter invalid face instances where face_valid is false or all keypoints are zero
extract_face_keypoints: extract face keypoints and visibility from raw annotations into numpy arrays with shape 1 K 2
